about.title: Ɣef
about.intro: {project} d tafelwit n bḍu n ifuyla peer-to-peer n tsuta tamaynut ibedden ɣef tetiknulujiyin timaynutin war ammas. Yesdukkul agrudem n useqdac fessusen d tunigit war ammas timmident, yefka tifrat taɣellsant d tuɣdimt i ubḍu n yisefka war asṛas ɣef tezmert tagejdant. Asenfar d ilelli (open source) yettwafrurex seddaw n {license}.

decentralized.title: Azeṭṭa war ammas timmidnit
decentralized.description: Ulac aqeddac alemmas, ulac yiwet n tezwit n turdit. Iseqdacen ttnadin u sserden agbur srid gar-asen, war asṛas ɣef yiseɣẓanen alemmasen, ineḍfaren neɣ tasenfawt n yisefka.

accessControl.title: Asenqed n unekcum n leqdic
accessControl.description: Yal yiwen yella d ilelli ad yebdu azeṭṭa-s s yilugan-is. Sbadu tiwuriwin n yiseqdacen di yal azeṭṭa: bab, anedbal, ameswagam, amsenkad d uneddar. Senqed s leqdic anwa yezmer ad iswagam, ad isnekkad u ad yesder agbur.

ui.title: Agrudem n useqdac n uswir afellay
ui.description: Agrudem n wammas n uẓawan zeddiɣen u yelhan i useqdac yebnan i tfelwiyin n udlif, n tilizyu d ubeḍḍal. Inig war uguren s tnasaft, n tɣerdayt, n gamepad neɣ n usenqed mebɛid. Iseqdacen leqqayen zemren ad seqdcen agrudem n yizirig n tladna i useqdec n useɣẓan am uqeddac n ifuyla war aqerruy.

dataFormat.title: Amasal n yisefka iqqaren n umdan
dataFormat.description: Amasal n yisefka LISH yebḍa ɣef JSON, ay yettarran ad yifsus axlaq, taɣuri d ufham. Bḍu agbur-ik s tsefranin ifrawan, izeddɣen, ay yezmer yal yiwen ad iẓer s leqdic.

security.title: Tudert tabaḍnit d tɣellist
security.description: Akk timyalsiwin n peer-to-peer ttwawagant, ay isgemmaɣen belli isefka-k ad qqimen n tbaḍnit deg unekcum. Iseqdacen zemren ad ffren deffir VPN i tsekka tarrayt n war isem. {project} yettqadar tudert-ik tabaḍnit s usuneɣ.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Aseɣẓan illa i tfelwiyin Windows, Linux d macOS. Seqdec di yal allal i tebɣiḍ.

download.title: Sader
download.description: Awi {project} i tfelwit-ik. Akk asider d ilelli u d open source.

macos.title: Tazmilt taxatart i yiseqdacen n macOS:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper isekkar isnasen war azamul / war notarised i d-yettwasdaren si Internet s tuccḍa {error}.
